Neugebauer, the co-founder and largest shareholder of Fermi Inc., has issued a statement in response to the company's decision to drop its lawsuit against him, which was filed to validate a 70% supermajority bylaw amendment. Neugebauer's claims challenging the validity of the bylaw remain alive and he will continue to pursue discovery and depositions of key players.

The Ascend 960DT chip will now be launched in the first quarter of 2027. Another variant of the new series, dubbed 960PR, will be delivered in the third quarter. Bloomberg's Anthony Stephens reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Turkey's Regulators Act to Stem Market Rout
general.summary: Turkish officials are trying to stop a meltdown at some of the country’s most prominent asset managers from infecting the wider financial industry. Several top finance executives were either detained or given travel bans as part of a widening investigation related to mass outflows from asset managers this week. Bloomberg's Beril Akman reports. general.summary: Indonesia’s new finance minister will retain the policy of his predecessor of keeping about $17 billion in the government’s standby funds with state lenders to help boost borrowing and economic activity.

general.summary: The European Central Bank will wait until December before delivering a final interest-rate increase to quell inflation triggered by conflict in the Middle East, according to economists.

general.summary: Shares of Chinese robotics‑component suppliers climbed after a local report said Tesla Inc. teams had arrived in the country to audit suppliers and place additional orders to boost production of its Optimus humanoid model.

general.title: BOJ Split Vote Sends Bearish Signal on Yen, Strategists Say
general.summary: The yen dropped after the Bank of Japan’s decision to hike rates as a split vote sent bearish signals, strategists said. The Japanese currency fell as much as 0.8% and bond markets erased earlier gains after the central bank raised its benchmark interest rate by a quarter percentage point to 1.25%.

general.summary: The yen extended its drop against the dollar after the Bank of Japan lifted interest rates as expected, with two dissents casting doubts on the outlook for further policy tightening.
